decision_type: DOCUMENTED PRE-Y FEASIBILITY DECISION — not a formal gate. No numeric feasibility threshold was registered in advance, so this artifact does NOT claim that a preregistered cutoff was crossed.
feasibility_finding: The FULL search scope was judged operationally infeasible after X-only enumeration because the realized hypothesis space implied prohibitive memory, permutation and capability cost relative to the qualified compute architecture.

trigger.reason: the frozen enumeration produced ~1.03M membership-distinct final claims, ~97% of them arising from the 3-bar grammar

primary_search.rationale: the primary localization question — in which quarter-hour of the opening hour does the change occur — is answered by the direct position-anchored transition

deferred.explicitly_not: deleted, judged, or found wanting on evidence
deferred.no_y: no outcome value and no descriptive outcome ranking may be produced for these families under this spec
future_paths: a separate 3-bar research family on a different period or dataset
a pre-specified smaller token vocabulary justified on domain grounds — never derived from 1H winners
an inference architecture built for ~1M-hypothesis search

support_floors.note: identical to SEQUENCE_GRAMMAR_V1/ESTIMAND_V1 and fixed BEFORE enumeration

window.requirement: complete opening hour required; incomplete -> excluded with a reason

estimand.block: exact T5 date x pre-window liquidity LOW/HIGH x pre-window volatility LOW/HIGH
estimand.anchor: T5-2 session close (20-session median dollar volume; ATR14/close)
estimand.null: Y permutation within registered blocks, one map across all claims

unchanged.selection_statistic: per T5_15M_INFERENCE_AMENDMENT_V2 — bounded blockwise Mann-Whitney, analytic null variance, search-wide max Z_rank

multiplicity_family.may_not: upgrade or confirm any 1H claim; a 15m result cannot change a 1H verdict
multiplicity_family.ledger: both exposures are recorded; k is accounted per family, not pooled, ONLY because the decision rule is declared per family in advance rather than "take whichever search looks best"

unchanged.note: no threshold was fitted to the observed X distribution

rejected_alternatives.raise_support_floor: would fit a threshold to the observed X distribution to reach a convenient k; outcome-free but still data-tuned
rejected_alternatives.hierarchical_2_then_3: would assume strong heredity — that a real 3-bar effect must have a detectable 2-bar parent. A->B can be null while A->B->C shifts the distribution.

provenance_statement: The 15m grammar and positional design predated 1H outcome exposure. The final inferential scope was reduced post-1H-exposure but pre-15m-Y, solely on documented 15m X-only computational and multiplicity feasibility grounds.
forbidden_phrasing: the 15m test was fully specified before the 1H result
mobility_rule: mobility is recomputed on the 2-bar-only final population and reported. No mobility floor is invented now; none was registered in advance, so min retention below 0.90 is reported, not failed.
next_steps: recompute the 2-bar-only funnel, exact re-equivalence, k_15m_2bar_final, mobility and gates
then: sealed claim order, q10/q50/q90 needles chosen by the frozen support rule from THAT order, 15m's own rank capability qualification
